# Brainspore Group LLC (BSG)

> Brainspore Group LLC (BSG) is a Kenya-based company providing software and IT solutions for Africa: custom ERP solutions, automations, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and payment and fintech solutions and integrations. Also known as Brainspore, Brainspore Group, BSG and BSG LLC.

Website: https://brainsporellc.com
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Email: hello@brainsporellc.com

## What Brainspore does

- Custom ERP solutions: one system for sales, stock, purchasing, finance and people, built around how a business actually runs.
- Automations: workflows that replace repeated manual work such as re-keying orders, chasing approvals and reconciling spreadsheets.
- Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central: setup, customisation and integration for finance, inventory and operations.
- Payment and fintech solutions and integrations: payment collection, wallets and integrations with M-Pesa and other payment providers.

## QSell

QSell is business management software built by Brainspore Group LLC. It runs sales, stock, finance, delivery and people in one system, and gives each business its own online storefront for customers.

## Founder

Paullaster Okoth (also written Paullaster Amolo Okoth) founded Brainspore and leads its engineering, with 8 years of experience building production software. Paullaster delivered the Engineers Board of Kenya membership portal, the Institution of Engineers of Kenya events and CPD portal, the National Research Fund grant management portal and the Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) staff portal.
